content.title: Verification commands that cd into a previous session's scratch directory fail instantly with exit 1 - environment artefact, not a product defect
content.problem: Recorded 'clean copy' checks (npm test, npm run test:browser, docs-check.sh) failed with exit 1 in 4-5 ms in every reconcile re-run while npm test in the working tree passes (271 pass). They were read as clean-checkout regressions but never executed the product.
symptoms: bash: line 1: cd: /tmp/claude-0/-mnt-sbx-work/b49d9a7f-.../scratchpad/clean: No such file or directory
reconcile --verify re-runs recorded checks and they fail again
clean copy npm test / test:browser fail but working tree passes
content.component: verification evidence / reconcile re-run of recorded commands

environment.dependencies: none (no node_modules; package.json has no deps)

rootCause.explanation: The recorded commands hardcode an absolute path inside the session scratchpad of session b49d9a7f, which no longer exists (only the current session dir exists under /tmp/claude-0/-mnt-sbx-work/). The scratchpad clean copy and the helper ../docs-check.sh lived there and were not persisted. The shell fails at 'cd' (4-5 ms), before npm runs. Ruled out: gitignored or untracked files missing from a clean copy (a copy built from git ls-files -co --exclude-standard, excluding .eccode, passes npm test 271/272 pass 0 fail 1 todo and test:browser 28/28; the project has zero npm dependencies so no install step is missing). Caveat: the original clean copy contents are unknowable now; its setup could have differed, but the log proves failure occurred at cd.

failedAttempts.approach: Hypothesis: files gitignored or untracked are missing from the clean copy (data/, eval/reports/, .env, node_modules)
failedAttempts.whyFailed: Rebuilt a clean copy honouring .gitignore: npm test and test:browser pass. No ignored path is required by tests.

failedAttempts.approach: Hypothesis: missing npm install in the clean copy
failedAttempts.whyFailed: package.json declares no dependencies and no node_modules exists in the working tree either.

solution.description: Rework: the owner of the verification evidence (ai-engineer/orchestrator) records clean-copy checks as one self-contained command that creates the copy itself in a fresh mktemp -d (git ls-files -co --exclude-standard, excluding .eccode) then runs npm test and npm run test:browser there, with no dependency on a prior session path or on ../docs-check.sh. Any docs-check script must be committed into the repo (e.g. scripts/) or inlined. Supersede the failed evidence by passing re-runs; do not edit src/ or eval/.
solution.tradeoffs: Self-contained commands are longer and re-copy the tree on each run (about 8-10 s). Also note nothing is committed (git log has one commit, all product files untracked), so a true git-clone clean checkout is not testable until files are committed; the ls-files -co approximation is used instead.

appliesWhen: A recorded check fails in milliseconds with 'No such file or directory' on a tmp or scratchpad path
reconcile re-runs evidence that depends on files outside the repo or from an earlier session
A clean-copy or clean-checkout verification disagrees with the working tree
notApplicableWhen: The clean-copy check ran for seconds and failed with test assertions (that is a real missing-file or ignored-file defect)
The failing path is inside the repo and exists

reasons: status provisional: not independently verified; treat as a hypothesis
